articles.title: The Slow-Mo World of Earth's First Animals — and How Sex Hit the Accelerator
articles.summary: For millions of years, Earth's earliest animals cloned themselves with runners, stalling evolution. Cambridge scientists used AI and fossil lasers to show that sex and stress finally unleashed biodiversity.

articles.title: Artemis III: NASA's Orbital Dress Rehearsal for a Lunar Return
articles.summary: In 2027, Artemis III will attempt unprecedented orbital docking tests with landers from Blue Origin and SpaceX. Four astronauts, including ESA's Luca Parmitano, will pave the way for a 2028 Moon landing.

articles.title: Cosmic Billiards: How NASA's DART Impact Altered an Asteroid's Solar Orbit
articles.summary: NASA's DART mission didn't just shorten Dimorphos's orbit around Didymos — it changed the entire binary system's path around the sun by 150 milliseconds. The finding boosts planetary defense strategies.
